title: check-skill-eval-tokens: read must_contain_any, so any-of tokens are shape-checked and must be taught like must_contain
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxBECSPtHxQMZDHSie

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37928. The source is the contract record 7220167777 on PR #37969 (nit N2) and L1-a's ACCEPT 7220192629 on the same head, which asks for this card before any further case moves to the any-of form. The owning area files it under the source card.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p3 · reach: every skill eval case that uses `must_contain_any` (today only objectstack-ai case 6; next readers case 12's carry 7207779687 and the English-phrase family 7207740184, card #37928 item 4) · evidence: read on `main`.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：技能评测有一道检查，确认每个「必含词」都是技能文档真的教过的词。PR #37969 新加了「几种写法任一即算对」的判分方式，但这道检查还不认识它：新写法里的词既不检查格式，也不检查文档有没有教。这张卡让检查也覆盖新写法。
- 谁受益：以后改用新写法的评测题，不会因为要求了文档没教的词而永远判错。
- 不做会怎样：今天只有第 6 题用新写法，它的四个词已人工核过都在文档里；等第 12 题等更多题改用时，就没人把关了。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
`ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` reads `must_contain` and `must_not_contain` only. After PR #37969 the skill-evals runner (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cases.ts`) also reads `assertions.must_contain_any`: a list of groups, each a non-empty list of non-empty literal tokens, a group met by any one token.
1. Shape: the gate's assertion-shape check covers `must_contain_any` with the same refusals `cases.ts` makes (not a list; a group that is not a list of strings; an empty group; an empty token).
2. Taught: each token of each group must be taught by the bundle the same way a `must_contain` token is (whole token in the bundle's own markdown). Decide and state in the PR whether a group needs every token taught or at least one; the contract record's reading is that every member should be something the skill says, since any one of them passes an answer.
3. Tally: a case whose only positive assertion is groups is no longer counted under the "must_contain is EMPTY" tally.
4. Self-test rows for each of the three, both directions.

## Acceptance
- `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` exits 0 on `main` with objectstack-ai case 6's four tokens checked (all four occur in `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`), and `--self-test` reds when the new branch is ablated.
- No verdict moves for any `must_contain`-only case. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- This strengthens an existing gate; it adds no new gate.
